authorization: User requested moving to P3b after the completed P3a audit. Local offline modeling only.

common_training.decision: Stop at first reached allowed checkpoint with mean group-pruned tree score >= fixed candidate threshold; otherwise continue.
common_training.ensemble: Flexible offline diagnostic predictor; not assumed deployable in current runtime.
common_training.features: Same exact qualified runtime fields within each profile; no IDs, evaluator strata, folds, roles, labels, future states or truth inputs.
common_training.group_support: After sklearn fitting, prune any split having a child supported by fewer than eight distinct training vectors. Replace it with the fitted parent value. Same rule for both methods.
common_training.preprocessing: No learned scaling, imputation, feature selection or global quantiles. Fixed scikit-learn float32 input semantics are reproduced in canonical exported predicates.
common_training.sample_weights: Each query contributes equal total weight within its vector: 1/(3 * reached_grid_states_for_query). Each vector totals one.
common_training.shallow_export: Depth-three tree plus canonical availability/eight-checkpoint guard. Validate artifact and interpreter parity on observed trajectories; no native execution or adoption.

continuation: Measured same-profile continue cost/outcome; no invented free routing gain. Analytical native reference reported separately.
inner_assignment: Training groups hash sorted by [20261024,p3b-inner-v1,outer_fold,group], round-robin four folds.
next_branch: If flexible supports a signal and shallow fails, investigate bounded representation/compression. If both fail, record a negative result for these finite procedures and inspect information/risk/diversity; no universal ceiling. Any targeted native acquisition needs a separate justification/contract.
outer_assignment: Reuse exact five 40-vector folds pinned in selective corpus.
protected_boundary: Use only already exposed 200-vector corpus, P3a definitions/pins and sealed API validation sources. No raw consumed confirmation, unexecuted60/reserved37 query values or canonical workloads.

reporting.also_report: Original -.005 recall replay bounds; proxy intervals, diagnostic risk320 outcomes, continue/native/fixed128 controls, checkpoint/filter errors, first-stop losses, selected and unselected inner candidates, all fold/model receipts.
reporting.cost_limits: Fixed-stop acquisition proxies only. Never pool old/new binary costs, transplant static costs to Light19, subtract P2 savings or reuse conditioned P2c timing as serving latency.
reporting.development_signal: Complete top-10 and native floors; same -.0025 lower recall bounds, positive mean proxy savings in both regimes and nonzero stop count. This is not final latency acceptance.
reporting.primary: Calibrated nested OOF first-stop recall/validity/coverage and acquisition cost proxies per method/profile; compare flexible minus shallow within profile using paired vector bootstrap.
reporting.uncertainty: Pointwise 10000-resample vector bootstrap on fixed OOF decisions. Prior adaptation/training uncertainty not removed; no independent confirmation or universal information ceiling.

reviewer: Codex correctness/result review; permanent artifacts for user review

selection.admission: All valid complete top-10; native mean recall >=.95 per filter; lower 95% recall delta >=-.0025 overall and every filter; positive mean activation AND reuse proxies overall; at least one stop.
selection.fallback: If no inner candidate qualifies, record explicit same-profile continue, with its measured costs; no outer-outcome rescue.
selection.fixed_diagnostic: Also refit risk320, threshold0 once for every profile/method/outer-fold regardless of selection; reuse if chosen risk320. Diagnostic first-stop outcomes never rescue a rejected candidate.
selection.inner_scores: Pool four inner held-out folds for each risk/threshold, covering all 160 outer-training vectors exactly once; fit and prune using the inner fitting groups only.
selection.outer_refit: Refit selected risk on outer-training groups only. Evaluate held-out outer groups once.
selection.ranking: Maximum min(mean activation proxy saving,mean reuse proxy saving); exact ties prefer larger risk then larger threshold.
selection.unit: One complete first-stop outcome per query, vector-group clustered across three filters.

stop_rule: One frozen nested campaign. No retuning after OOF results, additional model families, extra seeds/folds, global refit, production adoption, confirmation or automatic Torch acquisition. Preserve failed/incomplete campaigns; correctness repairs must not change scientific criteria or use outcomes to retune.
